_about: Text that replaces the API spec's wording in the generated files. Use only when the spec conflicts with a settled rule or is docs-UI text; every entry says why. Remove an entry when the spec is fixed.

bots_createBot.text: Send a bot to a Zoom, Google Meet or Microsoft Teams meeting, now or at join_at.
bots_createBot.why: The spec text describes the docs page UI (a dropdown), not the endpoint.

zoom.text: Zoom options. Plan on the customer's own Zoom app (Integrations > Zoom); meetings outside that app's account need zak_url or obf_url. Never tell users Zoom needs no setup.
zoom.why: The spec says use_own_app false joins 'without your app or credentials', which reads as no setup. Text aligned with skills/platform-setup and the Zoom copy rule. Open question P0 #7 for engineering.

zoom.use_own_app.text: true: require your connected Zoom app (400 without one). false: join without it, even when one is saved, with fewer features (see platform-setup). Omitted: use the app when one is saved or connected.
zoom.use_own_app.why: Same as zoom: states the API behaviour from skills/platform-setup without the no-setup reading.
